title: Recipe Library Move Check
summary: Check a recipe move before you import the family library.
user: A household switching between self-hosted recipe apps who needs to know what will be duplicated, lost, or unshareable before importing the family library.
smallest_useful_product: A local CLI that reads Mealie and Tandoor export folders, builds a neutral inventory, reports collisions and unmapped fields, and writes a reviewable migration checklist.
success_measure: For supported exports, 90% of recipe collisions and unmapped fields are identified before the destination import.
constraints: Run locally with user-exported data only.
